enabled.description: Whether IBus input method framework is enabled system-wide.

keyboard-layout.description: Keyboard layout used in the IBus setup dialog.

xmodmap-enabled.description: Whether to enable X11 xmodmap compatibility (legacy input methods).

show-icon-in-tray.description: Whether to show the IBus icon in the system tray.

use-system-language.description: Whether IBus uses the system’s locale language settings for input context.

engines.description: List of available input method engines (not necessarily active).

active_engines.description: List of engines to activate on startup (first engine is the default).

hotkey_toggle.description: Hotkey combination to toggle IBus on/off.

hotkey_next.description: Hotkey combination to switch to the next input method.

hotkey_prev.description: Hotkey combination to switch to the previous input method.

candidate_page_size.description: Number of candidate entries shown per page in the candidate window (5–10 recommended).

show-auxiliary.description: Whether to show auxiliary UI components (e.g., emoji picker, symbol palette).

show-input-indicator.description: Whether to show the active input method indicator inside applications.

unicode-control-enabled.description: Whether to enable handling of Unicode control characters (e.g., for right-to-left text).

default_language.description: Default locale for the input context (e.g., 'ja_JP.UTF-8', 'zh_CN.UTF-8').

use-pinyin-mode.description: Whether to use Pinyin mode by default for CJK engines (e.g., if ibus-pinyin is installed).
